item: The ledger tools' fence and code-span rule is one function, and the refs placeholder is one predicate
refs: R389 follow-ups; Opus read of #1639 findings 2 and 5; coordinator 2026-10-28 18:35; PR #1643
summary: lessons.outside_fences is the ledger tools' ONE fence rule, read by ledger_fold._prose, problems() and the lessons index: a fence closes only on its own character, at least as long, alone on its line; a backtick fence's info string holds no backtick; an unclosed fence is named with its line; a code span pairs backtick runs of equal length. _PLACEHOLDER also refuses #PRNUMBER, and ledger_shipped.check refuses a refs cell holding the word pending, #NNNN or #PRNUMBER through one REFS_PLACEHOLDER predicate (the test-side loop is gone). Measured over the 269 real files on main: 9 changed text, 0 changed placeholder verdict, 0 unclosed fence; the lessons index of the real tree (1,002 entries) is identical. 20 new tests red on the old tools, 27 of 27 mutants killed. Stated limits: the sweep script and release_notes.refs_carry_placeholder keep their own loops and predicate; code spans are per line.
